Features
The controller offers straightforward setup and flexible programming with three independent programs and up to four start times per program. Seasonal adjustment makes it easier to adapt watering duration throughout the year. children.text: е автономен контролер за 4 поливни зони, предназначен за системи без постоянно електрозахранване. Работи с 9 V бистабилни електромагнитни клапани и позволява отделно програмиране на поливането. Корпусът със защита IP68 е подходящ за монтаж в клапанна шахта и влажна среда според указанията на производителя.

Контролерът работи с една или две алкални батерии 9 V. Ориентировъчната автономност е около една година с една батерия или до две години с две батерии, в зависимост от условията и честотата на работа. Програмата се съхранява в енергонезависима памет, така че настройките не се губят при смяна на батериите.

The IP68-rated housing is suitable for damp environments and valve-box installation as directed by the manufacturer.

Комплектът улеснява изграждането на отделна зона там, където няма удобно мрежово захранване 230 V.

Основните компоненти са контролер ESP-9V, клапан 100-DVF с размер 1″ и подходящ 9 V соленоид. Контролерът управлява отварянето и затварянето на клапана по зададен график, а клапанът подава вода към съответния поливен кръг. Серията ESP-TM2 разполага с три независими програми и до четири начални часа за всяка програма. Може да задавате поливане в избрани дни от седмицата, през четни или нечетни календарни дни или през определен цикъл. Продължителността на работа на станция е от 1 минута до 6 часа.

en.description: Rain Bird ESP-TM2-4-230 is a 4-station automatic irrigation controller designed for outdoor installation. It schedules watering for individual zones and can be upgraded with an optional LNK2 Wi‑Fi module for remote control and notifications. Suitable for residential gardens and small landscaped sites. Power supply: 230 V AC; 4 stations; outdoor enclosure.

children.text: is a Rain Bird automatic irrigation controller for 4 independent stations. This version is designed for outdoor installation in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. It operates compatible solenoid valves according to a programmed schedule and lets each station have its own watering duration.

The ESP-TM2 family supports three independent programs and up to four start times per program. Watering can be scheduled on selected weekdays, odd or even calendar days, or on a repeating cycle. Each station can run from 1 minute up to 6 hours.

Seasonal adjustment changes watering duration throughout the year without rebuilding the complete schedule. Other functions include manual start, a watering delay of up to 14 days, a rain-sensor input and an output for a master valve or pump-start relay.

The controller can be upgraded with the separately purchased Rain Bird LNK2 module. After compatibility is confirmed and the module is connected to the internet, schedules can be managed from a mobile app. The Wi-Fi module is not included with this controller.

Power input: 230 V AC, 50 Hz; valve output: 24 V AC. Station count: 4. Choose the correct version: the indoor model must remain in a dry room, while the outdoor model must be installed as directed by the manufacturer and protected from direct water exposure.

When planning a system, match the number of stations to the available water flow and the hydraulic layout. The controller sequences valve operation; it does not increase the capacity of the water source.

Захранването е 230 V AC, 50 Hz, а изходът към клапаните е 24 V AC. Броят на управляваните станции е 12. Изберете точно версията за вътрешен монтаж: вътрешният модел трябва да остане в сухо помещение, а външният се монтира според указанията на производителя и се защитава от директно заливане.

При проектиране съобразете броя на зоните с дебита на водоизточника и хидравличното разделяне на системата. Един контролер не увеличава наличния дебит — той последователно управлява клапаните, за да работят зоните по график.

en.description: Rain Bird ESP-TM2I12-230 is an automatic irrigation controller with 12 stations, designed for indoor installation. It supports scheduled watering programs and can connect to the internet for remote control from a mobile device when paired with the optional LNK2 Wi‑Fi module. Suitable for larger residential gardens and landscaped areas with multiple irrigation zones. Power supply: 230 V AC; 12 stations; indoor installation.

children.text: is a Rain Bird automatic irrigation controller for 12 independent stations. This version is designed for indoor installation in a dry, protected location. It operates compatible solenoid valves according to a programmed schedule and lets each station have its own watering duration.

The ESP-TM2 family supports three independent programs and up to four start times per program. Watering can be scheduled on selected weekdays, odd or even calendar days, or on a repeating cycle. Each station can run from 1 minute up to 6 hours.

Seasonal adjustment changes watering duration throughout the year without rebuilding the complete schedule. Other functions include manual start, a watering delay of up to 14 days, a rain-sensor input and an output for a master valve or pump-start relay.

The controller can be upgraded with the separately purchased Rain Bird LNK2 module. After compatibility is confirmed and the module is connected to the internet, schedules can be managed from a mobile app. The Wi-Fi module is not included with this controller.

Power input: 230 V AC, 50 Hz; valve output: 24 V AC. Station count: 12. Choose the correct version: the indoor model must remain in a dry room, while the outdoor model must be installed as directed by the manufacturer and protected from direct water exposure.

When planning a system, match the number of stations to the available water flow and the hydraulic layout. The controller sequences valve operation; it does not increase the capacity of the water source.

children.text: — контроллер автоматического полива Rain Bird на 12 независимых зон. Эта версия предназначена для установки внутри сухого защищённого помещения. Контроллер управляет электромагнитными клапанами по заданному расписанию и позволяет назначать каждой зоне собственную продолжительность полива.

Серия ESP-TM2 поддерживает три независимые программы и до четырёх запусков для каждой программы. Можно выбирать дни недели, чётные или нечётные календарные дни, а также циклический график. Продолжительность работы каждой станции настраивается в диапазоне от 1 минуты до 6 часов.

Сезонная корректировка позволяет менять длительность полива в течение года без полного перепрограммирования системы. Доступны ручной запуск, задержка полива до 14 дней, вход для датчика дождя и выход для главного клапана или пускового реле насоса.

Сред съвместимите серии са ESP-TM2, ESP-ME3, определени версии ESP-ME, ESP-RZXe, ESP-LXME2 и ESP-LXIVM. Наличните функции може да се различават според серията и версията на приложението.

children.text: is an optional communication module that adds remote management to a compatible automatic irrigation controller. Once connected to the controller and a Wi-Fi network, it allows schedules to be adjusted and irrigation to be managed through the Rain Bird mobile app.

LNK2 connects the controller to the internet and provides access to schedules, seasonal settings and remote-control functions supported by the particular controller. This is useful for holiday homes, gardens and commercial sites when the owner or maintenance team is away. The module is not a stand-alone timer and cannot operate valves without a compatible controller.

Confirm that the controller carries the LNK Ready marking and that its model appears on Rain Bird's current compatibility list. Supported families include ESP-TM2, ESP-ME3, selected ESP-ME versions, ESP-RZXe, ESP-LXME2 and ESP-LXIVM. Available functions vary by controller family and app version.

The module plugs into the dedicated port on the controller. Initial setup uses Bluetooth Low Energy, after which the device connects to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. Reliable Wi-Fi coverage at the controller location is required for consistent remote management.

Type: Wi-Fi module for a compatible controller. Wi-Fi frequency: 2.4 GHz. Initial pairing: Bluetooth Low Energy. Connection: controller accessory port. Status indication: LED. The controller and internet access are provided separately.
